# zizmor --pedantic --offline baseline (scripts/templates/lint-workflows.sh)
# ONE LINE PER ACCEPTED FINDING: <tool>|<rule>|<file>|<route>  # why it is accepted
# Regenerate with: bash scripts/templates/lint-workflows.sh --update-baseline
# then WRITE A REASON on every new row by hand. A row with no reason is a
# finding nobody triaged, which is the thing this file exists to prevent.
#
# SHRINK-ONLY: a row that no longer fires FAILS the gate until it is removed.
# Never add a row to silence a NEW finding.
zizmor|adhoc-packages|.github/workflows/ci.yml|jobs.commitlint.steps[3]|x1  # @commitlint/cli@19 + @commitlint/config-conventional@19, installed into the workspace. This is an MQL5 header SDK with no package.json; adding one purely to satisfy this rule would create a second pin to drift. Both packages are major-pinned and the install is cached.
zizmor|template-injection|.github/workflows/ci.yml|jobs.required-checks.steps[0]|x3  # All three are ${{ needs.<job>.result }} inside the required-checks assert loop. That value is the closed enum success|failure|cancelled|skipped, produced by Actions itself and reachable by no input. Left inline deliberately: the loop is the aggregator's readable contract, and rewriting it through jq would hide the one thing a reviewer must check.
